resources.string: Accessibility detects Samsung Camera and its preview bounds, so grids follow changes to the camera mode and aspect ratio.
Accessibility grants broad access. This app reads UI positions; it does not perform taps, enter text, or record or upload screens and photos.
Example: One UI 8.5. Names and positions may vary with your system language or version.
Settings screenshot with the action highlighted: %1$s
Open Accessibility → Installed apps → Chrynalogia to check for a block. If the message below appears, close it and follow the next steps. If there is no block, skip to enabling accessibility.
Settings opens separately. Use Recent apps to switch between this guide and Settings.
First open and close the accessibility block message in the previous step. Open the Settings home below, scroll down, and select Apps.
In Settings → Apps, use search in the upper right to find Chrynalogia, then tap its name. To return to this guide, select Chrynalogia in Recent apps.
After selecting Chrynalogia from the application list in Settings, tap the three dots in the upper right. Opening app info directly from an app or the home screen may hide this menu.

Select Allow restricted settings and complete any device confirmation yourself. If the menu is missing, first open and close the accessibility block message, then go through Settings home → Apps → Chrynalogia again. If accessibility is available, skip this step.
Open Accessibility using the button below, then select Installed apps. You can also open it from Settings → Accessibility.
Tap Chrynalogia in the installed apps list. If it is still restricted, return to the Allow restricted settings step.
Turn on the top switch labeled Off. The separate Chrynalogia shortcut switch is optional; you do not need to enable it.

Read the Android permission explanation. If you agree, tap Allow yourself. Android describes the full capabilities of accessibility; Chrynalogia does not automate gestures or text input. Return to this app afterward.
Open Display over other apps below and turn on the switch beside Chrynalogia. This is needed to display grids above Samsung Camera. Return here afterward; the permission statuses below will update.
This app only works with Samsung Camera on One UI. It cannot be used on this device. You can still continue if you have a special setup.
Add SVG lines or PNG, JPEG, and WebP images. Images use one color and keep their original line thickness.
Turn off to stretch across the camera preview.
Automatically adds a white or black edge to contrast with the line color.
Always on displays the grid whenever the camera opens. Manual starts when you open this app and ends from the notification or on reboot.
Show stop button in the camera menu
Allow overlay and accessibility permissions first.

The accessibility service runs in the background to detect Samsung Camera. Always on displays grids whenever the camera opens. Manual mode starts when you open this app and ends from the notification or on reboot.
Accessibility reads camera UI coordinates and the foreground app on this device. Screens and photos are never uploaded.
Notification permission is needed for a manual overlay session.
Displaying composition grids in Samsung Camera.

Choose an SVG, PNG, JPEG, or WebP file.
Detects Samsung Camera and displays composition guides. Camera UI coordinates and button data are used for on-device debugging. Does not perform gestures or record the screen.
